thread:
Priyanka Rao: hey folks, new to the rotation this week. trying to complete the shadow checklist but ran into two things: 1) the "shadow handoff" doc link in the calendar invite 404s, and 2) my test alert acknowledged in PD but it didn't open the incident thread in Slack. who should I ping? :wave:
Owen Park: welcome Priyanka! ping me or @oncall-ops for the calendar doc. The Slack bridge needs the incident key in the PD note to open a thread — if your test alert had an empty details field it won't create a Slack thread. What did the PD test payload look like?
Priyanka Rao: I used the web UI test alert -> description: "test - priya". PD shows the incident id but Slack didn't create a thread.
Leah Martinez: we recently tightened the bridge to avoid spam; it only opens Slack threads for alerts with a `service` tag matching our list. If it's a custom test it might not map. Owen, can you confirm mapping for "shadow-test" service?
Owen Park: checked the bridge config — "shadow-test" wasn't in the allowed list. I've added it. Priyanka, can you re-trigger the test with `service=shadow-test`? Use: `redwoodctl alert send --service=shadow-test --desc "shadow test Priyanka"`
Priyanka Rao: re-triggered and Slack thread appeared, thanks! Calendar link still 404 though.
Arjun Shah: calendar doc moved to Confluence recently, old URL deprecated. I'll update the invite. For now, here's the shadow handoff checklist snippet: "1) join Zoom with your shadow at shift start, 2) observe first two alerts, 3) runbook preview for each service, 4) ask questions in the post-shift retro." Copy paste that into notes.
Priyanka Rao: perfect, paste incoming. Also noticed the runbook for payments-queue is missing the `esc` command to escalate to L2. Is that expected?
Leah Martinez: good catch. We keep escalation commands in docs/escalations.md and per-service runbooks should link there. Could you open a docs PR with the missing command? Label it `docs: runbook` and request review from @payments-owner. If it's blocking during a page, paste the command in the incident Slack thread and ping @sre-leads to merge a hotfix.
Priyanka Rao: will open the PR. One more question: during shadow shifts, can shadows ack alerts on my behalf or do I need to do the ack myself?
Owen Park: shadows should let you do the ack so you get the hands-on experience. If it's SEV1 and you're blocked, shadow can take control but annotate the incident notes that they acted for you.
Priyanka Rao: got it. thanks everyone, this cleared up a lot. :pray:
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete "Shadow Orientation" checklist and verify PD->Slack integration by running a test alert before your first live page.
